name: Rin Rinrin
source:
A Chinese foreign exchange student. A master of eradication of malignant spirits and tai chi, she is hostile towards Ami, whom she views as "a mere phantom".

Always seen eating steamed buns.

Likes: Steamed buns, bustling places
Dislikes: Anything half-cocked
Hobbies: Tai chi, buying all different kinds of steamed buns
